close_reason: added check_validity and time_to_unix_secs; x509_cert::time::Time::to_unix_duration() available directly on the enum
description:
Implement check_validity(cert: &Certificate, now_unix: u64) -> Result<()> that checks notBefore <= now <= notAfter per RFC 5280 §6.1.3(a)(2).

x509-cert represents validity as x509_cert::time::Validity { not_before: Time, not_after: Time } where Time is an enum over UTCTime and GeneralizedTime (both from the der crate).

Conversion to unix timestamp:
  der::asn1::UtcTime and der::asn1::GeneralizedTime both implement Into<SystemTime> or have a to_unix_duration() method (check der 0.7 API). Convert to seconds-since-epoch for comparison with now_unix: u64.

Edge cases to handle:
  - UTCTime year interpretation: years 00-49 = 2000-2049, years 50-99 = 1950-1999 (RFC 5280 §4.1.2.5.1)
  - GeneralizedTime with sub-second precision: truncate to seconds
  - now_unix == 0 means caller forgot to set it; document that 0 will fail all validity checks (intentional — no silent clock skew)

Returns Error::ValidityPeriod { index } on failure (index is injected by the caller, the §6.1 state machine).

Test vectors: use OpenSSL to generate certs with known notBefore/notAfter; verify correct accept/reject at boundary conditions.
title: pkix-path: validity period checker
